📌HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) is a Kubernetes feature that automatically scales the number of pods in a deployment based on resource usage metrics.

📌It ensures that enough resources are available to meet the application's demand and can help improve its availability and performance.

😉 We present this video in which our expert What Horizontal Pod Auto Scaler is all about.
